entityDescription:
Barcelona School of Economics (BSE) is an institution for scientific cooperation for research and graduate education in Economics and Data Science. It was founded in 2006 by four academic institutions: the Department of Economics and Business at Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF); the Unit of Foundations of Economic Analysis at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UFAE-UAB); the Institute for Economic Analysis (IAE-CSIC); and the Center for Research in International Economics (CREI).
BSE was founded to pursue research excellence, it is driven by a world-class faculty and draws on the strengths and reputation of its four academic units. The BSE research community includes Affiliated Professors, Post-docs, Visitors, and PhD students. BSE has obtained three consecutive Severo Ochoa accreditations (2012-15, 2016-19 and 2020-24), which has supported BSE to become one of the leading clusters of economics research in Europe and worldwide.
Barcelona School of Economics is an institution where graduate education and research are closely linked. The core of all BSE educational and research activities are the Affiliated Professors. BSE Affiliated Professors are tenured or tenure-track faculty members from the four academic units (DEE-UPF, UFAE-UAB, IAE-CSIC and CREI). In April 2024, BSE had 152 Affiliated Professors: 122 have a PhD from a non-Spanish university and 78 of them are non-Spanish. Among them 18 are ICREA Research Professors. A total of 42 ERC Grants have been awarded to current BSE Affiliated Professors since the beginning of the program. 10 BSE Affiliated Professors are Econometric Society Fellows. According to RePEc, the reference data repository in Economics, 22 Affiliated Professors are ranked among the top 5% and 50 are ranked among the top 10% of economics researchers worldwide. The BSE research community includes also 16 Post-doctoral researchers, 2 BSE research Fellows (external academics with a stable collaboration with BSE) and 98 pre-doctoral researchers, enrolled in the two PhD programs co-organized by BSE: Economics, Finance and Management PhD program at Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) and International Doctorate in Economic Analysis, at Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB).
BSE offers two master degrees in Economics and one master degree in Data Science, besides short courses for professionals. The BSE programs are very international (on average 90% are international students) and are recognized and respected by prestigious universities, companies, and organizations across the globe. In addition, these master programs are a gateway to prestigious PhD programs.
On the research side, BSE has since its inception the ambition to be recognized as one of the top institutions in Europe and worldwide for research in Applied Economics, Macroeconomics Microeconomics and Data Science. To achieve that, BSE community is engaged by plenty of research activities, such as seminar series, the BSE Lectures, the Calvó-Armengol International Prize Lectures, in collaboration with the Andorran government, and the BSE Summer Forum, a two-week conference with more than 30 workshops that attracts hundreds of researchers from around the globe to Barcelona to present cutting-edge research.

entityDescription:
Quantum Network Design specialised on the design, development but also simulation of quantum networks and their associated protocols in realistic, noisy scenarios. The studied models include noise stemming from gates and storage in NISQ devices alongside noise in channels connecting quantum networking nodes. The simulation engine uses a variety of different computational approaches including efficient classical simulation methods for the study of complex quantum networks running distributed quantum applications in a realistic scenario. These scenarios include not only the noise quantum operations, storages and channels but also all the classical messaging, waiting times and computation times amongst other crucial parameters.
The core competences of Quantum Network Design lie in:
Design, simulation, architecture and protocols for quantum networks

The founders of Quantum Network Design (Wolfgang Dür and Alexander Pirker) have a demonstrated and internationally recognized history in proposing and developing protocols for quantum networks. The protocols include protocols to distribute entangled states within a network, to also combat large-distances amongst nodes but also protocols for generating arbitrary graph states within a network. Furthermore, protocols to achieve reliability have been developed, underlining this competency of Quantum Network Design. Furthermore, Quantum Network Design implements a simulator for quantum networks in a highly configurable manner, allowing operators to change storage and gate noise models but also channel noise models connecting individual nodes. The simulator takes into account for waiting times due to operations, classical messaging but also the dynamic availability of channel and nodes in a network.
Security aspects in quantum networks

Both founders of Quantum Network Design have worked on the security of quantum networks relying on entanglement purification protocols. It was proven that security in a quantum network is always feasible in case the end-nodes have the capability to run entanglement purification protocols, under the assumption of powerful eavesdroppers controlling the entire network. This background is vital to designing a secure DQC network as part of this project.

Since 2023, the airline is part of Vector Group – a union of distinguished aviation entities with offices in Ireland, Israel, Malta, and Bulgaria. Vector Group manages one of the most efficient aviation companies in Southern Europe, including ETG Maintenance, an EASA Part-145 maintenance provider; Maverick Horizon, a progressive leasing company; and Classic Air, which acts as both a sales agent and an aviation broker.

Electra Airways provides services to leading tour operators, airlines and brokers within the industry.
Operating a fleet of 8 modern aircraft; 1 x Airbus A320 231 (registration mark LZ-EAB), configured to 180Y; 3 x Airbus A320 232 (registration marks LZ-EAC, LZ-EAD and LZ-EAI), configured to 180Y; 3 x Airbus A320-214 (registration mark LZ-EAE, LZ-EAH and LZ-EAF), 1 x Airbus A321 111 (registration mark LZ-EAG), configured to 219Y.

Our main activity is providing cutting-edge technological solutions that enable our clients to achieve high quality and efficiency in production. Key areas include the manufacturing of parts for the automotive, aerospace, and industrial sectors, the development of innovative automation systems, and the implementation of technological solutions for various industries.
MECASYS's products and services also include the production and repair of molds, CNC machining, electro-erosive machining, the design and production of clamping fixtures, as well as 5-axis milling and metrology services. Furthermore, we offer comprehensive services in the field of industrial automation, where we design and implement custom automation solutions for our clients.
Our personnel consists of a team of 40 experienced professionals, both internal and external, who continuously work on improving and educating themselves in the latest technologies and innovations.
Our material and financial capacities are bolstered by a modern machinery fleet equipped with advanced 5-axis CNC mills, electro-erosive machines, and 3D measuring systems, enabling us to execute projects with a high degree of precision.

entityName: Jan Evangelista Purkyne University in Usti nad Labem
entityDescription:
Established in 1991 on the basis of the former Pedagogical Faculty, our university currently comprises eight faculties (Faculty of Art and Design, Faculty of Arts, Faculty of Education, Faculty of Environment, Faculty of Health Studies, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Faculty of Science, and Faculty of Social and Economic Studies).
We have adopted the name of the renowned North-Bohemian native of LibochoviceJ. E. Purkyně(1787–1869), an outstanding biologist, pharmacologist and anthropologist, and one of the founders of modern physiology. Just as well-rounded a personality Purkyně in his time was, we too, in these days, offer a wide variety of study programmes (more than 50 programmes with more than 150 specialisations) focusing on the most varied areas of human activities. We educate around 8500 students and employ a staff of about 900, of those around 500 in academic positions (that is a student-to-faculty ratio of 17:1).
We are proud of being the only university founded and located in northwest Czechia, the region with stunning environmental diversity as well as a turbulent political and economic history over the last two centuries. This all, along with diverse intellectual traditions at our university, create a unique research and educational ecosystem to address the most pressing challenges faced by the society in our region and beyond.

Astra-Terra is a London based company specialising in cutting-edge solutions for Positioning Navigation and Timing (PNT), earth observation, smart cities , and tech solutions for sustainability and resilience. The company has a proven track record of delivering research projects, collecting, modeling, testing and validating data; analysing failure modes and designing mitigation techniques to develop robust architectures in PNT solutions. In addition, Astraterra is engaged in projects addressing the design of earth observation data platforms tailored to specific solutions such as disaster management and biodiversity.

Astraterra also, offers technical and business consultancy for other start-ups in the space domain and its related fields. Astraterra also works on training and capacity building and information dissemination for various stakeholders including evidence-based policy. 
Astra-Terra is an active member of the TechUK and UKSpace and The Royal Institute of Navigation (RIN), International Astronautical Federation(IAF) Europe Sub-Committee (EU-SC) and works closely with Imperial College London and its consultancy arm: ICON.

Exprivia CZ S.r.o. was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Exprivia S.p.A. (Italy) in the Czech Republic on March 11, 2024. The incorporation process was facilitated with the support of a local consulting firm, Vistra Shelf Companies s.r.o. 
To streamline the process, Vistra proposed the acquisition of an inactive shelf company. As outlined in the share acquisition agreement, Vistra acted as our representative in all actions required for the acquisition of 100% shares in Ivin International s.r.o., located at Nádražní 344/23, Smíchov, 150 00 Praha 5, Id. Nr. 19196644, and registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, Folio 382890 (“Company”). 
The shares were acquired from Vistra Shelf Companies s.r.o., registered in the Commercial Register maintained by the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, Folio 178238, for a purchase price of 10,000 CZK. Subsequently, Ivin International s.r.o. changed its name to Exprivia CZ S.r.o.
The incorporation of Exprivia CZ S.r.o. reflects Exprivia commitment to providing its international clients with answer to increasingly localized services. Furthermore, it has been crucial for participating in an EUSPA tender. As highlighted in the attached "Extract of Commercial Register," the company is duly constituted with the identification number 191 96 644.
As to date:
- the company has not yet commenced any economic activity
- On July 22, 2024, as communicated by the Tax Authority of the Czech Republic, the company obtained its VAT number (CZ19196644)
- The local consulting firm is responsible for fulfilling the tax and administrative obligations required by local regulations, even though the company remains inactive at this time
- The governance of the company includes one director, Donato Dalbis
- All strategic decisions are made exclusively by the 100% parent company, Exprivia S.p.A.

entityDescription:
Blue Orbit Space Systems is a company focused on the space and plasma technology sector, dedicated to research and development of advanced propulsion systems and related technologies. Founded in 2022 by a multidisciplinary team of highly skilled and passionate scientific and engineering professionals, Blue Orbit aims to become a leader in the field of space propulsion and space exploration.
This leadership within the space industry will be achieved through the unique expertise brought in by each of the founders. Firstly, future Dr. Rene Cartaya Lopez, a Physics graduate specializing in plasma process chemistry and passionate about space technology. Secondly, Engineer Ahymerd Riveras, specializing in production and telecommunications, with a keen interest in system optimization and efficiency. Thirdly, Dr. Abraham Vivas Borda, a mechanical engineer with a PhD in renewable energies, devoted to realizing a sustainable vision for the future of space. Fourthly, MSc. Felix Konefka, a specialist in plasma physics, a generator of innovation in the space sector. Lastly, Engineer Marco Cen Puc, a mechatronics specialist, enthusiastic about system automation.
Our focus is on developing advanced propulsion technologies that drive space exploration in a more efficient and sustainable manner. We work closely with space agencies, academic institutions, and private companies to promote innovation and take our solutions to the next level. Moreover, our commitment to excellence extends not only to science and engineering but also to the customer experience, providing personalized solutions and exceptional service. We strive to understand each customers unique needs and deliver tailor-made solutions that propel their success and help them reach new heights in space exploration.
Our primary goal is to turn bold ideas into tangible realities and contribute to scientific and technological advancement on a global scale. Challenging ourselves every day to push the boundaries of what is possible and forge new paths towards the stars.
In addition to our endeavors in space, Blue Orbit is also exploring terrestrial applications of plasma technology. Among these applications are: seed treatment through cold plasma exposure, where we can stimulate growth, increase resistance to diseases and pests, and improve overall performance. Activated Plasma Water, through the use of cutting-edge technologies, we develop systems that activate water at a molecular level, enhancing its quality and properties. This activated water has applications in various fields such as agriculture, health, and industry. Lastly, leveraging the properties of plasma, we develop innovative processes to decompose and transform waste materials, thus contributing to reducing environmental impact and promoting a circular economy.
In summary, at Blue Orbit, we are passionate about space and believe in the power of technology to drive human progress both in space and on Earth. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and leadership in the space industry. Join us on this exciting adventure towards an interplanetary future and discover how we are transforming the space landscape to pave the way for humanity to reach the stars.

entityDescription:
Our company is advancing industrial-grade EEG technology through early-stage, proof-of-concept solutions designed to meet the unique demands of high-stakes environments, including space missions, maritime operations, and industrial transport. Currently at Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3, we are focused on developing and validating proprietary artifact deletion algorithms alongside rugged, adaptable EEG hardware tailored for extreme conditions where conventional EEG devices cannot operate effectively.
At this stage, our core R&D efforts center on refining our artifact correction technology, a key component of our intellectual property (IP) strategy, to ensure high-fidelity, real-time brain monitoring in challenging industrial contexts. This includes testing our algorithms in simulated environments to validate their effectiveness in filtering out environmental noise and physiological artifacts—an essential requirement for safety-critical applications.
Our collaborations with hardware manufacturers and research institutions support this validation process, allowing us to co-develop prototypes that can withstand the operational demands of industrial and remote settings. Additionally, we are building partnerships with OEMs and industry stakeholders in health tech, focusing on IP licensing and modular integration options for future commercial deployment.
At TRL 3, we are laying the groundwork for patentable IP and proof-of-concept demonstrations that will underpin our transition to field-ready EEG solutions. Our mission is to create technology that not only elevates safety standards in critical industries but also enables accurate, non-invasive neurological monitoring where it has never been possible before. As we progress, we aim to secure additional research funding and partnerships that will support our journey toward scalable, compliant EEG solutions designed for the most demanding environments.
